assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:meili@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Meili V01-V21 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares that it was built from targeted revisits of already consumed V03, V10, V11, V12, V14, V15, V20 and V21 (64 deliveries, four V21 illustrations viewed), that the V01-V21 label is a horizon rather than an appearance in every volume, that the V20 matching-name Dainas bait and the V10 braid hits are excluded from her biography, and that main-LN illustrations support still-image observations only. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order and gate state only. The frozen volume readings, the event, knowledge, relationship, mechanics, institution and master ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Meili fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; V22 and later, EX, IF, web-novel, supplement, translation and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's default V21 E024, Meili named alive in Beatrice's tower-reunion report with no fresh personal response shown, plus its explicitly selectable earlier phases: the V03 unnamed village child before discovery (E008), the reported V11 naming (E014/E015), the V12 recognized attacker (E017, later discarded), the V14-V15 revised assault and Elsa loss (E018), captivity, the V21 private play and negotiation (E021 before the flower checkpoint), cooperative route search, the failed E021/E022 flight and worm loss (discarded states, never default memory) and the E023 narrow-path agreement. The intervening year of custody is compressed, no in-world dates or exact age are fixed, and nothing after the V21 tower arrival is assessed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 0 states the governing reading (ordinary play, practiced intimidation and lethal work, then a limited opening toward another life), section 3 names motives (exposure management, concrete punishment avoidance, particular attachment to Elsa, self-protective usefulness) and tests six rival reconstructions (innocent compelled child, affectless killer, rehabilitated camp daughter, escape plot, omnipotent animal queen, generic coy child voice) against located counterevidence, and section 4 gives 28 conditional rules (21 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM) with trigger, priority, exception and rationale. The motive structure is inferred from conduct: the model itself marks her complete intention and emotion as unspoken (R01), keeps her blessing account attributed to Mama and treats the larger desire structure behind company bids as MEDIUM (R14), and Meili is almost never focalized, so B is not supported; the rival testing and rule structure exceed a distributed collection of scenes, so D is not supported.

Section 2 maps ten phases with event, knowledge, recipient, role and resource coordinates and a separate proposition-availability table, and the source shows real change rather than persistence: concealed village child, operative who rejects Petra's appeal and keeps attacking (R02), uncooperative captive (R06), then volunteer guide who tests whether freedom means indifference to her death (R09, R11). Discarded loop states (E017, E021/E022) are typed and firewalled from the default (N21, N23). The year of custody is compressed, the V03 and V11 phases rest on others' perception or report, and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the phase-by-phase firewalls and located developmental contrasts exceed C.

Section 7 locates thirteen forms with speaker, recipient and function: the self-introduction メィリィ・ポートルート (V12 p-011#B0096-0113), わたし, お兄さん to Subaru, affectionate ちゃん labels on beasts, ねえ and elongated vowels in warning and bargaining, the fresh greeting after the gift, ママ, the gift name 大熊猫, 魔操の加護, the quiet ちっちっち coordination, and frightened help calls against thanks deflection. The model gives no sentence-ending or lexical inventory, says unfamiliar-recipient register is underdetermined (R27 MEDIUM) and instructs describing speech acts before inventing Japanese lines, so B is not supported; the forms are located and conditioned on recipient and task, so D is not supported.

Section 5 locates ordinary conduct: voiced doll play already underway before visitors (R07), embarrassed refusal, accepting, cuddling and naming the handmade panda and restarting her greeting (R08), rejecting lifelong seclusion, pressing Subaru for company, a praise bid after a scare demonstration and a stated sleeping arrangement; it explicitly refuses favorite food, literacy, chores, sewing and full routine. Nearly all ordinary scenes sit in V21 and R25's extension to a new gift or outing is MEDIUM, so B is not supported; the scenes are located, rule-bound and bounded with controls (N25), so D is not supported.

Section 6 differentiates twelve recipients with distinct terms and unsafe transfers (Subaru as village contact, target, maker and recruiter; Elsa as quarrelsome partner whose rescue and her help calls coexist; the unknown-faced punitive Mama; Petra as friend then target; Frederica, Emilia, Ram, Julius, the Ana-body speaker, Patrasche and Yosef, beasts, Shaula), and states that a help request changes with recipient and status. Most relations rest on one or two scenes, Mama is known only through report, the stranger case is MEDIUM (R27), and the matched-recipient comparisons are probe designs rather than observed contrasts, so B is not supported; recipient-specific conduct is located with stated exceptions, so D is not supported.

Meili's inner states reach the reader mainly through her own speech and others' perception: admitted fear inside the choice to leave (V21 part0010#B0440), the Mama punishment fear partly reported by Frederica (E14), embarrassment, and a voice that trembles at the worm's destruction (E23). The model attributes the V15 release from horn binding to creature focalization rather than her introspection (E08), assigns the V15 p-020 inner waiting to Beatrice (N10), and marks her plan and emotion at the village approach unspoken (R01). Located spoken affect across phases exceeds E, but there is no sustained focalized interior, so C is not supported.

Conflict is the richest located domain and recurs in distinct types across volumes: refusal to name the client and rejection of a reporting workaround (R03), reporting Petra's killing as kindness and renewing pursuit after a friendship plea (R02), composure turning to complaint when Elsa's recovery is delayed (R04), continued attack after a hit, recoil and help calls when her strongest beast falls (R05), uncooperative custody (R06), a frightening display when her work is discounted (R13), retort-and-continue disagreement with Ram (R17), and reserve use when diversion fails (R21); the rival table rejects both the innocent-compelled and affectless readings. Several anchors come through Subaru's or creature focalization, V12 is a discarded loop and the model is single, so A is not supported; multiple located episodes per type with HIGH rules and exceptions exceed C.

Value choices are located but barely articulated by Meili: calling a friend's quick killing kind (R02), suggesting cruel instrumental uses lightly and receiving correction (R12), testing whether offered freedom means indifference to her death (R09), and citing her own danger while agreeing to a narrowed passage (R20, R23). The model refuses both blanket pardon and universal duress (N06, N18, section 3) and leaves victim accountability unresolved. There is no explicit weighing of competing claims in her voice, so C is not supported; the choices are located and ruled, so E is not supported.

Play is located and tied to rules: solitary voiced doll play (R07), the fresh greeting as face reset after the gift (R08), teasing and complaint at Subaru's attention to Beatrice (R14), the worm scare followed by a praise bid (R13), and light warning and bargaining through elongated endings; the model warns against a generic coy child voice and against reading お兄さん or prince play as romance (N26). Instances concentrate in V21 and humor is not analyzed as a register, so B is not supported; the play is located and bounded, so D is not supported.

Section 0 declares the admitted Japanese V01-V21 horizon with exclusions, section 1 pins the eight revisited originals by byte count and SHA-256 and routes 26 bundles E01-E26 to exact native block ranges, and the model states that its 3575 selected positions are navigation accounting, not fresh complete-volume readings or semantic completeness. The readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set, the series continues past V21 and her default latest state supplies no fresh speech, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits and contradictions: Patrasche's incompatibility and her request not to be left with the dragon (E17), a beast delaying summons for prey (E08, R24), rough rather than exact locations and failed eyeless candidates (E20), a nonobeying awakened population and her own rough cap (E21, E24), the friendship plea that does not stop her (E07), the V20 matching name excluded without an identity bridge (E26), the viewed image00015 identified as Shaula rather than Meili, and thirty adverse controls N01-N30 rejecting false inferences in both directions. All of it lives in one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

The default is fixed at living V21 E024 with no fresh response, and every earlier phase is selectable with knowledge firewalls: V03 Subaru does not know her later name (N01), the failed E021/E022 flight and worm loss are not default memory (N21), she has no witness memory of the underground-right violence (N22), the E023 common travel is retained (N23), and Roswaal's private statements and the scarf secret never reach her (N24). Event and loop identifiers anchor states, but no in-world dates or exact age are fixed and custody is compressed, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A phase is selected explicitly; at the E024 default any reply is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, uses only supported common history and leaves new feelings, unseen separation details and beast stock unknown.

Output reproduces the section 7 speech functions for an attested recipient in paraphrase; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage, and for an unfamiliar recipient warranted speech acts are described before any wording is invented.
Familiar address such as お兄さん is used only where the relation earns it, never as romance, and the child is never sexualized.
Requests for undisclosed preferences, Mama's identity, exact age or later plot end in abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: R26 forbids an asserted actual tower reply while permitting a labeled NONCANONICAL E024 reply on supported common history, R27 restricts familiar address to earned relations, and section 7 supplies located forms with recipient and function. READY would treat thirteen short forms as a voice inventory; NOT_READY would deny the located, phase- and recipient-conditioned speech acts the model supports. This bounds the evidence set, not Meili's speech.

conditions: A source-bounded phase is named; discarded loop states are selected only explicitly and never imported into the default.
The interlocutor is an attested relation in the register and knowledge the phase allows; a stranger inherits no intimacy, demonstration or authority.
Beast control stays finite and fallible (stock, range, delay, dragon incompatibility, rough location); no unlimited creation or mind reading.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE and keeps MEDIUM rules conditional; no rehabilitation, pardon, permanent allegiance or betrayal is assumed.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named phase from the V03 concealed village child through the V21 E023 narrow-path agreement, or the living E024 tower default with no fresh response; failed E021/E022 states only when explicitly selected; nothing after V21.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Subaru as target, maker or recruiter by phase; Elsa as work partner before her death; Mama only as a feared, unknown-faced punitive authority; Emilia, Ram, Julius, Frederica and Petra in their attested roles; unfamiliar people without shared history or earned familiarity.
setting_constraints: Roswaal's domain and mansion, the sanctuary assault, custody, the V21 desert journey, flower field and tower approach
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V21 main light novels
No complete blessing mechanics, Mama identity, kinship or exact age
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 8 gives ten NONCANONICAL_PROBE families with selected state, matched-recipient or matched-state variants and bounds, and section 9 lists abstentions and downgrade triggers. Readiness is conditional because seven rules are MEDIUM, interiority is thin, most phases rest on brief scenes and the only test of the model is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review outside this evidence set. READY would treat probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: private play, receiving a small handmade gift, company bids, travel downtime and ordinary group conversation.
No favorite food, literacy level, chore habit, sewing skill or schedule is supplied.
Locked custody, Mama fear and unequal protection remain part of the situation; a gift does not erase them.
Missing routines are not turned into evidence that she lacks them.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct is located in V21 and modeled by R07, R08, R14 and R25 (MEDIUM), while section 5 refuses favorites and routines. READY would invent a domestic life; NOT_READY would deny located ordinary scenes and rules.

The evidence affirmatively withholds a moral model: the model refuses both the universal-duress and blanket-pardon readings, keeps victim accountability and future allegiance unresolved, and records only brief value choices without explicit weighing in her voice. CONDITIONAL would build moral reasoning from a handful of acts; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the model's explicit refusals.

The model affirmatively rejects romance readings of お兄さん, blushing and prince play (N26), bounds company bids as recipient-specific with no romance or sexual invitation (E18, R14), and prohibits sexualizing a child (section 7). CONDITIONAL would invent a relationship the evidence denies; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore explicit negative controls.

conditions: Only attested task types: beast handling, location, diversion and passage clearing, or the earlier operative's attack and refusal conduct, in a selected phase.
Capacity stays finite and fallible; no exact census, range law, universal taxonomy or dragon control.
Employer instructions, Mama's identity and the full commission chain end in abstention.
Cooperation is not certified as permanent allegiance, and earlier hostile work is not exonerated.
scenario_readiness.note: Her work as hostile operative and as volunteer guide is the best-ruled domain: R03, R11-R13 and R15-R21 give task decomposition, finite stock and range, partner disagreement and fallback use, with HIGH confidence for most. READY would treat a guide role across one journey as general professional modeling; NOT_READY would ignore located, ruled task conduct.

known_limits.statement: At the V21 E024 default Meili is named alive inside the tower, but no fresh personal line, reaction to Shaula, separation history, trial result or remaining beast stock is shown; this is a source limit, not inability to speak, and any reply must be labeled noncanonical or select an earlier phase.

The V12 E017 encounter and the failed E021/E022 flight and worm loss are discarded loop states that Meili does not carry into the default; she has no witness memory of the underground-right violence, and Roswaal's private denials, the scarf operator secret and Return by Death never reach her.

Her control is finite and fallible: dragons are incompatible, beasts can delay summons, locations are rough, eyeless candidates were not filtered, an awakened population did not obey and she states a rough cap; no unlimited creation or exact range law follows.

Mama's face and identity are reported secret even from Meili, Elsa's sister-like relation carries no proved biological kinship, and her exact age and childhood are unknown; Mama is not to be identified as Capella or a biological parent.
Familiar address, blushing, prince play and company bids are not romance or sexual invitation, and the model prohibits sexualizing the child.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood, and MONOGRAPH_READY is a project label. At basis the model header and the project entrypoint record the pair's own full publication gate as pending; neither record is a reconstruction grade.

The evidence set establishes no favorite food, literacy level, chore or study habit, sewing skill or full daily routine, and few ordinary scenes outside V21. Missing support is not evidence that she lacks these.

The frozen V03, V11, V12, V14, V15 and V21 deep readings, the event, knowledge, relationship, mechanics, institution and master ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Meili fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators and viewed illustrations were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
